OVERALL.recommended_fix: New module alpha_engine/active_picks_sync.py invoked inline from forward_validator. Reuses existing failover price fetchers. Estimate 2-3h with tests. This is the upstream of the 'signal_outcomes 82d stale' incident already filed.
